objects.name: IIS Header Injection Authentication Bypass
objects.description: Microsoft IIS 10.0 on Windows 11 25H2 improperly processes HTTP headers X-HTTP-Method-Override, X-Original-URL, and X-Forwarded-For. CVSS 9.8 Critical. Reported to Microsoft MSRC Case 124937 / CRM:0022143789. Patch available.
objects.x_mitre_detection: Monitor IIS logs for 405→200 anomalies. Alert on X-HTTP-Method-Override, X-Original-URL, X-Forwarded-For headers.

objects.name: Wizard Spider
objects.description: Russia-based financially motivated threat group. Attack chain: Emotet → Trickbot → SMB lateral movement → Ryuk ransomware. Exploits CVE-2026-XXXXX for initial access. COSA OMEGA confirmed.
Wizard Spider exploits CVE-2026-XXXXX for initial access, deploying Emotet loader, Trickbot payload, and Ryuk ransomware.

objects.name: CVE-2026-XXXXX Mitigation
objects.description: Apply Microsoft patch. Block X-HTTP-Method-Override, X-Original-URL, X-Forwarded-For via IIS Request Filtering and URL Rewrite. Deploy WAF rules.
